main.summary: Durable phase of a transfer publication operation.

value.name: Prepared
value.summary: The publication request has been recorded but publication processing has not started.

value.name: Publishing
value.summary: The transfer session is undergoing publication validation and assembly.

value.name: Published
value.summary: Publication artifacts have been written or adopted successfully.

value.name: CatalogUpdated
value.summary: The catalog has been updated for the published item.

value.name: Finalized
value.summary: The transfer session has reached its terminal published state.

value.name: OperatorActionRequired
value.summary: Publication conflict requires operator action before publication may resume.

value.name: Failed
value.summary: The publication operation reached an unrecovered failure state.
